title: Getting a Turkish Tax Identification Number (Vergi Numarası) Online
seoTitle: Turkish Tax Number for Foreigners: Online GİB Guide
metaDescription: Get a free Turkish Potential Tax ID online via Dijital Vergi Dairesi. Learn when foreigners need a Vergi Numarası, passport tips, and timing.
quickAnswer: Foreign nationals can obtain a free 10-digit Turkish Potential Tax Identification Number (Potansiyel Vergi Kimlik Numarası) online in minutes through the official [Dijital Vergi Dairesi portal](https://dijital.gib.gov.tr/foreigners/kimlikNoBasvuru) run by the [Turkish Revenue Administration (GİB)](https://gib.gov.tr/). You only need your valid passport details, a Turkish address (such as a hotel or lease), and an active phone number.

body.text: Almost every formal business, property, or banking step in Türkiye starts with one administrative prerequisite: a 10-digit Turkish tax number (Vergi Kimlik Numarası). The good news is that you do not need to pay a fixer or stand in a district tax office queue just to obtain your initial number. At [Itinerary of Türkiye](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/), our two founders help international clients structure practical business and relocation-scouting trips on a transparent, client-paid flat fee ("Paid by our clients. Independent of provider commissions."). We coordinate visit schedules, banking or notary logistics, and independent introductions, while tax registration, filings, and legal advice belong strictly to licensed Turkish attorneys, certified public accountants (SMMM), and official authorities.
How do foreigners get a Potential Tax ID free via the official Dijital Vergi Dairesi?

Visit the [Dijital Vergi Dairesi Potential Tax Number Application](https://dijital.gib.gov.tr/foreigners/kimlikNoBasvuru) operated by [Gelir İdaresi Başkanlığı (GİB)](https://gib.gov.tr/). Select the English interface, enter your passport data, parents' first names, and a Turkish contact address, then submit. The portal generates a downloadable official PDF certificate immediately at zero government cost.
Because the service is completely free, avoid third-party websites charging service fees for the exact same form. Follow this step-by-step checklist when completing the online application:

items: Use the official .gov.tr URL: Confirm your browser is on https://dijital.gib.gov.tr/foreigners/kimlikNoBasvuru before entering any personal data.
Enter names in uppercase Latin letters: Match the machine-readable zone (MRZ) at the bottom of your passport bio page, omitting accents or special characters.
Prepare parents' first names: Turkish civil and tax registries require your mother's and father's first names; enter them in plain uppercase letters.
Provide a valid Turkish address: A confirmed hotel address in Istanbul or a leased apartment address is accepted for an initial Potential Tax ID.
Save and print the PDF immediately: Download the confirmation PDF as soon as it appears, and keep both a digital copy and two printed copies for notary or bank visits.

body.text: What tasks require a Turkish Tax ID (bank account, TAPU, Ikamet, company setup)?

Foreigners need a Turkish Potential Tax ID to open a personal or corporate bank account, purchase real estate and complete a title deed (TAPU) transfer, pay [residence permit (](https://dijital.gib.gov.tr/hizliOdemeler/gocIdaresiIkametTezkeresiHarciOdeme)[İkamet](https://dijital.gib.gov.tr/hizliOdemeler/gocIdaresiIkametTezkeresiHarciOdeme)[) fees](https://dijital.gib.gov.tr/hizliOdemeler/gocIdaresiIkametTezkeresiHarciOdeme), sign notarized powers of attorney, or register as a shareholder or director of a Turkish company.

Having a Potential Tax ID does not automatically make you a Turkish tax resident or create an ongoing tax filing obligation on its own. It simply assigns you an administrative identifier in the national system.

body.text: Once you receive an approved residence permit (İkamet) or work permit, Türkiye issues a Foreigner Identification Number (Yabancı Kimlik Numarası starting with 99), which typically replaces the Potential Tax ID for domestic administrative transactions.
What common passport-entry mistakes cause errors?

The most frequent errors on [Dijital Vergi Dairesi](https://dijital.gib.gov.tr/foreigners/kimlikNoBasvuru) are including middle names in the wrong field, typing accented or non-ASCII characters, reversing day-month-year date formats, or mixing up the passport issue and expiry dates. Any mismatch between your tax certificate and your physical passport will cause a bank or notary to reject the PDF.
Watch closely for four technical pitfalls:

items: Middle names: If your passport lists a middle name under "Given Names," enter both first and middle names in the Name (Adı) field exactly as printed in the MRZ.
Turkish character keys: Avoid using lowercase i vs. dotted İ issues; type all fields in plain uppercase English letters (A–Z).

Existing tax number conflict: If you visited Türkiye years ago and already had a Potential Tax ID issued under an older passport, the portal may flag a duplicate record and direct you to visit a local district tax office (Vergi Dairesi) in person with your current passport.
Pop-up blockers: The final PDF certificate opens in a new browser tab or download prompt; disable aggressive pop-up blockers before clicking submit so you do not lose the confirmation page.

body.text: How long does online issuance take?

Online issuance through [Dijital Vergi Dairesi](https://dijital.gib.gov.tr/foreigners/kimlikNoBasvuru) is usually instantaneous, taking roughly five to ten minutes from start to PDF download. If the system detects a duplicate profile or requires manual passport verification, an in-person visit to a district tax office typically resolves the issue within one business morning.

Because banks and notaries sometimes verify the tax number against internal GİB feeds, complete your online application at least one business day before your scheduled Istanbul appointments. faq.q: Does getting a Potential Tax ID mean I have to pay taxes in Türkiye?
faq.a: No. A Potential Tax ID is only an administrative registration number. Tax liability depends on Turkish tax residency rules or Turkish-source income, which you should confirm with a licensed Turkish SMMM accountant.

faq.q: Can I apply for a Turkish Potential Tax ID before arriving in Türkiye?
faq.a: Yes. The [Dijital Vergi Dairesi portal](https://dijital.gib.gov.tr/foreigners/kimlikNoBasvuru) is accessible from abroad, though you will need a valid Turkish address (such as your upcoming hotel) and a working phone number to complete the form.

faq.q: What should I do if I lose my Potential Tax ID PDF?
faq.a: You can retrieve or verify your number through the [Dijital Vergi Dairesi](https://dijital.gib.gov.tr/) verification screen using your passport details, or request a printout at any local district tax office (Vergi Dairesi) with your original passport.

faq.q: Do I need a new tax number if I renew my passport?
faq.a: No. Your 10-digit tax number stays assigned to you, but you should have your new passport details updated at a district tax office so banks and notaries do not flag a passport-number mismatch.

faq.q: Can a Turkish bank branch issue a tax number for me?
faq.a: No. Banks cannot generate a tax ID on your behalf; you must bring your printed GİB Potential Tax ID certificate (or your 99-prefixed Foreigner ID card) to your branch appointment.
